subject: Renewal addendum: term proration + seat reallocation (redline coordination)
messages:
From: Peter Zhang <peter.zhang@synapseworks.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: Emma Li <emma.li@procure-synapse.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal addendum: term proration + seat reallocation

Rishi,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. We want to move forward with the 12‑month renewal but need a short addendum to handle two items before signature:

- Prorated billing for the current partial month (we're switching billing cadence mid-term).
- Reallocating 50 seats from Team A to Team C (no net new seats; only reassignment).

Attached is a candidate addendum with our initial redlines (Synapse_Addendum_Redline_v1.docx). Legal will need Redwood's counter‑redlines on the proration schedule and the seat transfer language (we want clear language that moves seats without triggering a new onboarding fee).

Can you confirm who on your side will take the redline? If we can close the addendum, procurement wants to push signature through DocuSign by end of week.

--
Peter Zhang
Head of IT Procurement
SynapseWorks

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Peter Zhang <peter.zhang@synapseworks.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal addendum: term proration + seat reallocation

Peter — thanks for the note and the draft. Looping in Aditya from Legal and Lauren from RevOps so we can coordinate redlines and the sign path. Quick plan:

1) Aditya will review the legal language for seat transfer (confirming no onboarding fee trigger).
2) Lauren will propose the exact proration schedule (we'll send an XLS with calculations).
3) I will consolidate our counter‑redline and share a single document back to you by EOD tomorrow.

Attachments: putting the updated schedule and a visual signature‑path diagram on a quick deck so procurement can confirm the DocuSign route.

Next steps: Aditya / Lauren — can you take the initial pass today? If anything looks like it will require exec approval (e.g., changes to SLA or credit language) flag it and we'll escalate.

Rishi
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: signature-path-diagram.png (png)]

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Cc: Peter Zhang <peter.zhang@synapseworks.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal addendum: term proration + seat reallocation

Thanks Rishi — first pass from Legal below. I added inline comments in Synapse_Addendum_Redline_v3.docx and highlighted two items that need clarity before we provide a negotiated redline:

1) SLA/credits: the customer's redline removed a paragraph that limits cumulative SLA credits in a 12‑month period. We can accept a one‑time exception for this renewal if Synapse wants it, but it needs to be time‑boxed and scoped; propose: "one‑time SLA credit carveout limited to incidents reported in the current renewal term only."

2) Seat transfer mechanics: current wording allows seat reassignment but includes an ambiguous phrase about "additional setup costs." We recommend explicit language: "Seat reassignment between existing teams shall be permitted without additional onboarding or setup fees, provided no net increase in total contracted seats occurs."

3) Proration schedule: Lauren — your calc will determine wording for the billing clause. I'll leave the technical proration math to RevOps and will reflect the final schedule in the addendum wording.

If Synapse insists on a broader change to data retention or audit access language, escalate — that's a Legal + Security review and will add time.

--
Aditya Rao
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Synapse_Addendum_Redline_v3.docx (docx)]

From: Peter Zhang <peter.zhang@synapseworks.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: Emma Li <emma.li@procure-synapse.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jul 2025 15:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal addendum: term proration + seat reallocation

Aditya / Rishi — appreciate the quick turnaround. We reviewed Aditya's suggested wording and are comfortable with the one‑time SLA carveout as written. Two quick asks before we sign:

- Can you confirm the proration math? Emma is attaching the interim invoice; we need to ensure the credit posts to this billing period.
- DocuSign: procurement prefers the Redwood legal contact on the signer block. Please confirm the sign path (we will need the envelope ready by end of day Friday).

I attached the procurement-ready invoice and a short note from our finance team showing the target accounting treatment. If both proration and seat transfer wording are accepted, we can sign the addendum and route via DocuSign.

Thanks —
Peter
